fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: GenerationId
fields.about: The generation ID of the group.

fields.name: ProtocolName
fields.about: The group protocol selected by the coordinator.

fields.name: SkipAssignment
fields.about: True if the leader must skip running the assignment.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member ID assigned by the group coordinator.

fields.name: GroupInstanceId
fields.about: The unique identifier of the consumer instance provided by end user.
